answer:
I've completed the research on TAC Protocol's TAC token. Here's a summary of the key findings:

## Key Findings

**Current Status (July 18, 2026):** TAC trades ~$0.00355, market cap ~$17.2M (rank ~#877), roughly **95% below its all-time high** of $0.06654 set just one week earlier on June 30, 2026.

**The Defining Event — July 7 Flash Crash:** TAC collapsed **>90% in ~15 minutes** (from ~$0.06 to ~$0.004–0.005), coinciding with its Binance Alpha/Binance Futures listing. This was one of the sharpest crypto flash crashes of 2026.
- **Team's explanation:** Denied any hack or insider selling; blamed a large perpetual futures sell order that overwhelmed thin liquidity and cascaded into liquidations.
- **Structural risk:** Top 10 wallets control ~72.34% of supply, plus heavy airdrop-recipient selling.

**Recent Trend:** Continued sliding to ~$0.0025 around July 9 (-43.89% 24h), then stabilized in the $0.0025–$0.0036 range with occasional volatile bounces.

**Technical Analysis (Jul 9):** Critical support at $0.0020 (break exposes $0.001344 ATL); resistance far above at $0.0349/$0.0536 (pre-crash levels); RSI ~29.94 (deeply oversold); trading well below the 50 EMA (~$0.0243).

**Vesting/Unlocks:** 27.24% complete with ~728 days (~2 years) remaining. Unlocked 2.72B TAC, locked 2.39B, untracked 4.89B (~49% of FDV — a significant overhang). Next unlock ~99.43M TAC (~$358K) imminent. Allocation is heavily weighted to Early Contributors (22.1%) and Seed (16.6%).

**Data caveat:** Some prediction pages still cite stale pre-crash figures (~$0.046–$0.051, ~$233M–$262M cap); live trackers consistently confirm the ~$0.0035 current level. The full report and structured data (11 key facts, 11 sources, 22 data points) have been submitted.
